name: Sorted Histogram Visualization
definition: A 2D histogram that retains the intuitive appearance of a traditional 1D histogram while conveying a second attribute. It solves the problem that traditional 2D histograms make it hard to assess occurrence (voxel count) at a glance and cause peaks in intensity to be smeared across the second dimension.
summary: Sorted Histogram Visualization is a multi-dimensional transfer function tool that sorts voxels by a secondary attribute within intensity bins, revealing clear distributions where traditional histograms obscure them.
